categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Dahongli Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of complete sets of crushing and screening equipment for sand, stone, and mining industries. Its product portfolio includes hydraulic cone crushers, gyratory crushers, high-pressure roller mills, impact crushers, jaw crushers, vibrating screens, and integrated crushing production lines. The company also provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services and after-sales support.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced hydraulic and mechanical crushing technologies, including single-cylinder and multi-cylinder hydraulic cone crushers, gyratory crushers, and high-pressure roller mills. It integrates intelligent manufacturing with automated control systems for real-time data acquisition and dynamic adjustment of production parameters. The production process emphasizes green manufacturing with dry and wet processing techniques to ensure environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises in infrastructure, metallurgy, construction, and mining sectors such as China Railway, China Electric Power Construction, and regional government-owned enterprises. The company serves domestic sand and gravel mining, metal mining, and construction waste recycling markets. It also targets overseas markets, especially in Southeast Asia along the Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China, with sales offices covering major domestic mining regions and Southeast Asian countries including Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia. It has established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Indonesia to expand its international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Dahongli operates primarily in the midstream segment of the mining equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of crushing and screening machinery. It also provides integrated EPC solutions and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive equipment and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on product automation, intelligence, and environmental sustainability. R&D efforts target upgrading existing product lines and developing new equipment tailored for metal mining and green mining initiatives. It emphasizes digital transformation, artificial intelligence integration, and smart manufacturing to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly generated through direct sales of crushing and screening equipment, including complete production lines and spare parts. The company also earns income from engineering services (EPC), installation, maintenance, and after-sales support. A small portion of revenue comes from leasing and rental of equipment and facilities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic manufacturers in the sand and mining crushing equipment industry, recognized for its high-quality and technologically advanced products. It competes with other specialized equipment manufacturers in China and has a growing presence in international markets. Its comprehensive product range and integrated service model provide a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 371.8 million, a 31.65% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.14 million. Despite the revenue decline due to market downturns, the company maintains substantial total assets exceeding RMB 1 billion and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion. It faces challenges from reduced downstream demand but is actively pursuing market diversification and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu Dahongli emphasizes integrated, intelligent, and environmentally friendly crushing solutions that offer high efficiency, stability, and automation. Its products are designed for durability under harsh conditions, suitable for diverse climates from high-altitude cold regions to tropical areas. The company’s value proposition includes rapid response after-sales service, customized solutions, and a full lifecycle approach from design to maintenance, enhancing customer operational efficiency and reducing total cost of ownership.
